title: Localization tensor comparison preserves Koszul braiding
statement: Let C be an abelian Grothendieck closed braided monoidal category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions, and a derived category in its Grothendieck Hom universe. Equip its complexes with total tensor and its derived category with the native derived monoidal structure and descended braiding. For all complexes K,L, β(QK,QL) followed by μ_Q(L,K) equals μ_Q(K,L) followed by Q(β(K,L)). Hence the same compatibility holds on all K-flat sheaf models, without needing the K-flat hypotheses in this equality. The predicate NativeBraidingAt is exactly this equation, defined with the coefficient category abstract so specialization retains the canonical structure arguments without re-elaborating the full morphism formula.

source.place: Tags 08J9, 08JA, 08JB, 08JC, 0A90 and 0G7D; the indicated part of the external global-Hom evaluation argument.

proof.text: The homotopy quotient has identity tensor comparison. The braiding compatibility for Qh is DerivedMonoidal.braiding_hom_μ. Compose these two lax monoidal functors.

Transport this compatibility along quotientCompQhIso. Expand the transported lax tensor comparison and use braiding naturality with the two inverse iso components; then use naturality of the forward component. This is exactly the native lax structure of Q.
